Most of the time Porcellus cooks for Jabba and his court, but when he is free, he creates his delights here.|[[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] and Porcellus|audio=Porcellus1.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
'''Porcellus''' was a balding [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was assisted by [[Phlegmin]], the kitchen boy. Before working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], he worked for [[Yndis Mylore]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Oh, I must return to the kitchens before your praise overcooks my ego. Please, do come again.|Porcellus|audio=Porcellus2.flac|<ref name="Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale" />}}
Porcellus was a [[Chef/Legends|chef]] of considerable skill, having won both the [[Golden Spoon]] and [[Tselgormet Prize]] numerous times.<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine">''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''</ref> Early in his career, he worked for [[Yndis Mylore]], the governor of [[Bryexx]].

Eventually, he ended up working for the mighty [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. He lived in constant fear, knowing that if he made one bad meal, Jabba would feed him to [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|his rancor]].<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine" /> While he was Jabba's chef he became friends with the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] dancer [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] and [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], the [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] keeper.

Porcellus found it necessary to hide the choicest morsels and meals behind an electrified fence in his kitchen to keep the Palace's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] and [[Phlegmin]], the kitchen boy, from stealing too many "samples". This, incidentally, kept him alive, as he did not wish to see his master going hungry.<ref name="Secrets of Tatooine" />

Porcellus sometimes used to cook large wild creatures for Jabba, including [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizards]], [[rock beetle]]s (to prepare [[beetle broth]]), [[Squill (creature)|squills]] (to prepare [[squill liver salad]]), [[dragonet]]s or [[zucca boar]]s.<ref name="SWG:JPP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Porcellus hired a spacer to steal several bottles of [[Corellian Merlot]] from [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian pirates]], who stole the shipment soon before.<ref name="SWG:JPP" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] when several bodies were turning up with no explanation as to how or why they had been murdered, he found [[Ak-Buz]]'s [[Death/Legends|murdered]] corpse in his kitchen, and hid the body. He also drove [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]] out of the kitchen's garbage area, believing the guard had intended to steal food. In actuality, Jubnuk had been rummaging through the trash to find Jabba's [[Tusken battle talisman]], which had been misplaced.

Porcellus later met [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] after she was captured by Jabba and forced to serve as the Hutt's personal slave during her botched rescue of the Corellian smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Porcellus fell in love with the Alderaanian princess but realized that she herself was in love with Solo. Due to his compassionate nature, he decided to help Solo, and fed him select meals to hasten his recovery from hibernation sickness, helping to keep him alive, despite feeling great sorrow that the smuggler held the Princess' affections instead of him. For this he was thanked by Leia. Porcellus's life was soon in jeopardy, however, when Jabba accused him of putting a [[Fierfek/Legends|fierfek]], or hex, on the food, noting that others such as [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] and Jubnuk, who consumed his cooking, died shortly thereafter. He was sentenced to death. However, Jabba was killed before the sentence could be carried out and Porcellus was freed by Malakili. They later founded a restaurant together called the [[Crystal Moon Restaurant/Legends|Crystal Moon]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Porcellus_Insider_60.png|thumb|left|90px|Porcellus from [[Star Wars Insider 60|''Star Wars Insider'' 60]].]]
In the article [[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]], Porcellus is illustrated as a heavy-set man with a mustache and cap. The drawing greatly resembles [[Rayc Ryjerd]].

[[File:Porcellus_SWG.jpg|thumb|The original Porcellus in ''Star Wars Galaxies''.]]
Porcellus appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Porcellus was present in the original release of the game, being part of the so-called [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Jabba's Theme Park]]. Originally, Porcellus was bald and wore dark green clothes.<ref name="SWG:P" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> the Jabba's Theme Park was extensively [[W:c:swg:Jabba's Theme Park|revamped]] and the quests given by Porcellus were completely modified. In addition, his appearance was changed to a more chef-like one, with black hair, a white apron and a chef's hat.<ref name="SWG:JPP" />

The name "Porcellus" is [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]] for "piglet" or "suckling pig".<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.latin-dictionary.net/definition/30946/porcellus-porcelli|text=Latdict: "Latin definition for: porcellus, porcelli"|archivedate=20140911162216}}</ref>
